verdict.rationale: Better Auth ships an official CLI, documented at /docs/concepts/cli. It is shown as `npx auth init` and referenced in the device-authorization docs as 'the Better Auth CLI'. Community users corroborate that it handles schema generation and migration ('one CLI command puts all your auth data in your own DB', 'CLI-generated migration made switching easy'). missing for 10: detailed first-party evidence of the CLI's command set in the pack, evidence of AI/agent-oriented CLI features (e.g., machine-readable output or agent workflows).
